result.summary: Found 2 issues. The main visible defect is overlapping text in the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card metadata row. There is also a minor inconsistency in the delivery-time badge on the first 'Fastest near you' card. The carousels' clipped right-edge items and the partially visible pizza card at the bottom are expected and not reported.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the metadata line has overlapping text. The delivery time ('25–35 min') collides with the delivery fee text ('€0 delivery'), producing a garbled, unreadable string. The two text elements are rendered on top of each other.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the delivery time and fee with proper spacing, for example in a single flex row with separators and no absolute positioning. Add truncation or wrapping so the elements cannot overlap.

issues.description: The '15–25 min' time badge on the Green Bowl Poké card looks misaligned and cramped. It overlaps the plate image and sits slightly off compared to the badges on the neighboring cards, and its white pill looks like it bleeds into the light background because the card background is so pale.
issues.suggestion: Give the badge consistent positioning and padding across cards. Add a subtle shadow or border so it stays distinct on light image backgrounds.
